content: Direct competitor PokemonPriceTracker.com already does daily-updated sealed product tracking (English + Japanese) sourced from TCGPlayer, with an EV (expected value) calculator per set/box (sums card pull-rate-weighted market prices) and ROI vs MSRP. This EV-calculator angle is a notable differentiator pattern seen in the sealed-product-specific niche, distinct from poe.ninja's simpler current-value-only display.
